title: POLAR Posture Recognition: Person-Centric Four- and Nine-Class Benchmarks
description: Audited four- and nine-class POLAR benchmark comparing DINOv2, DINOv3, SigLIP2 and ConvNeXt V2. Development-nominated conservative fusion obtains 95.211019% macro-F1 on 3,329 four-class test images and 94.583075% on 6,984 nine-class images. The immediate prior models remain retained under the locked promotion rules. Includes 32 public prediction sets, audited cohort membership, paired statistics, training code, technical reports, figures and preserved historical POLAR/V-COCO studies. The four-class test was previously inspected and is nested in the nine-class test; no external state-of-the-art ranking is established. Images and model weights are not redistributed. This metadata does not indicate a Zenodo deposit, DOI or peer review.
